analysis_options.max_basetype_size: Architecture value loaded by BfdArchitecture::init; every requested size is <= 8
analysis_options.factory_state: Fresh BfdArchitecture TypeFactory after architecture.init; requests are made in the declared order, followed by dependentOrder, clearNoncore, and one anonymous size-3 recreation
analysis_options.normalization: None; one fixed-order compact UTF-8 JSON object plus final newline is compared byte-for-byte
analysis_options.random_seed: none; TypeFactory operations and fixture traversal are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: Named same-id conflicting definition only; no allocation or lock failure injection

assets.source_policy: Materialize every SLEIGH/spec file and curl binary from verified Git blobs at the pinned Rugra provenance commit; never consume their working-tree copies and never require runtime HEAD equality

binary.source_policy: Materialize the pinned provenance commit's examples/curl Git blob by its verified object ID; never read the working-tree file and never require runtime HEAD equality

observation_schema.format: One compact UTF-8 JSON object with fixed key order and a final newline
observation_schema.type: Requested size, returned size, metatype string, exact name, unsigned id, and inheritable/core flag
observation_schema.identity: Repeated same-factory pointer identity for each size, cross-size non-identity, and named repeated identity
observation_schema.factory_mutation: dependentOrder projection of every unnamed TYPE_UNKNOWN before clear, after clear, and after recreation
observation_schema.clear_identity: Repeated post-clear retrieval returns the recreated pointer; no pre-clear pointer is dereferenced or compared after Ghidra deletes it
observation_schema.order: Request/result arrays preserve declared input order; anonymous structural order preserves TypeFactory tree traversal order

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-type-unknown-lib-snapshot-v2 plus sorted length-prefixed paths and contents from pinned base commit with the owned TypeFactory overlay

build.cargo_mode: Pinned Rugra commit archive plus the owned src/type_system/typefactory.rs overlay, with Cargo.lock-verified local registry archives vendored into a temporary CARGO_HOME; --locked --offline; no other live Rust source is read
build.ghidra_mode: git archive of the locked Ghidra commit plus rebuilt libdecomp.a
build.input_mode: All four SLEIGH/spec assets and curl are materialized from verified Git blobs at the pinned Rugra provenance commit
build.runner_mode: Re-exec from an immutable file descriptor, reject path substitution, validate its snapshot hash, then build the fixed commit-plus-owned-overlay closure without requiring runtime HEAD equality

coverage.external_old_handle_lifetime_identity: UNTESTED: Ghidra deletes non-core objects during clearNoncore; Rust Arc retention is a different lifetime condition and is not compared

overall_status: UNTESTED: (B2 migration of partial match state) targeted unknown atomic-base, structural-order, and clearNoncore observations match; large-base array conversion and general TypeFactory registry remain untested/mismatch
